cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So what will you cook?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rule says hosting counts as effort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does it mention cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not once hosting has been counted generously enough.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who issues those?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can't schedule a blink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That will take all afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Lend me your good tennis racket. I'd like my talent to have a fair surface. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you admit it helped?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll thank the strings. The strokes remain mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use your own racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let inferior equipment take credit for my defeat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you admit it helped?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll thank the strings. The strokes remain mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use your own racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let inferior equipment take credit for my defeat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can you tell me the winning cake temperature without becoming my co-baker?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want my secret recipe too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the degree at which my original idea should happen.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the temperature quietly so my achievement can concentrate.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is clearly bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then you won't mind witnessing how much bigger.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was an honest mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely opening. Add 'and that was unfair to you.'
